pick.name: Razorpay
pick.what: Indian PG: UPI, cards, netbanking, subscriptions, payment links
pick.why: Lowest-friction direct INR collection; individuals/unregistered businesses can onboard via no-GST route
pick.free_limits: 2% platform fee on domestic (incl. UPI; UPI MDR is 0 but platform fee applies) + 18% GST on fee; card subscriptions +0.9%; intl cards up to 3%; no setup/AMC

alts.name: Cashfree Payments
alts.free_limits: Standard 1.95% domestic (+GST); intl Visa/MC 2.99%, Amex 2.95%; festive offer: 0% platform fee on first Rs20L GMV until 31-Mar-2027 (ends early if exhausted)

alts.name: Dodo Payments (INR via MoR)
alts.why: Zero extra integration; MoR handles GST to buyer

candidates.name: PhonePe PG
candidates.verdict: ~1.95-1.99% standard per third parties; no official page fetched

decision: At first, let Dodo collect INR so you run one billing integration. Add Razorpay when INR revenue is meaningful: ~2.36% all-in vs ~4% + 15c, but then you invoice and charge GST yourself once registered.

verify.note: Razorpay docs confirm a 2% platform fee (UPI 0 MDR but 2% applies; the doc self-conflicts with UPI QR at 0.99%), +18% GST on the fee, card subscriptions +0.9%, intl up to 3%, no setup/AMC, and that unregistered individuals can onboard with PAN. BUT the Cashfree alt is stale: Cashfree's page shows standard 1.95% and a festive offer of 0% platform fee on the first Rs20L GMV until 31-Mar-2027, not a '1.6% promo ended 2026-07-31'. For a $0-first founder starting INR collection before Apr 2027, Cashfree is cheaper, if it onboards unregistered individuals (not verified).

better_pick.name: Cashfree Payments
better_pick.reason: 1.95% standard vs Razorpay 2%, plus 0% platform fee on first Rs20L GMV until 31-Mar-2027; verify individual onboarding
